title: Refresh the prospective focus after a retained opening's original scope is refused
outcome: A scope refusal after selecting the original held opening preserves that refusal while allowing a bounded prospective refresh and a useful next-turn remedy.
acceptance: When a focus switch initially keeps the original opening but its original root later fails scope validation, the original turn remains refused and uncredited; the prospective focused association is refreshed only after its existing authority checks, or a bounded notice tells the agent to name or confirm its root.

A behavioral regression for a remotely ended original root verifies retained refusal, the notice and remedy, and subsequent prospective association behavior without weakening claim/root fences or the closing budget.
